title: 2013 AMC 10B Problem 13
statement: Jo and Blair take turns counting from \(1\) to one more than the last number said by the other person. Jo starts by saying “\(1\)”, so Blair follows by saying “\(1,\) \(2\)”. Jo then says “\(1,\) \(2,\) \(3\)”, and so on. What number is spoken in position \(53\)?

solutions.text:
Through the turn ending with \(n\), the total number of numbers spoken is \[ 1+2+\cdots+n=\frac{n(n+1)}2. \]

After the turn ending with \(9\), exactly \(\frac{9\cdot10}{2}=45\) numbers have been spoken. The next turn is the list \(1,2,\ldots,10\), so its eighth entry is the \(53\)rd number spoken. That entry is \(8\).

Thus, the correct answer is E .
hints: Find the triangular number just before \(53\)
The next spoken list starts again at \(1\)
